title: Pan-Seared Sirloin Steak with Kenyan Spices
description: A classic German-inspired sirloin steak recipe with a twist of Kenyan spices, pan-seared to perfection. This dish is a hearty and flavorful option for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Season the sirloin steaks with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the sirloin steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the steaks to a plate and let them rest.
Add the kenyan spices to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the charred paella rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the kenyan spice mixture.
Serve the sirloin steaks with the kenyan-spiced paella rice and enjoy!
